items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The change is short and has a clear comment ("# Ensure base table is in the query"). The guard `all(self.query.alias_refcount[a] == 0 ...)` copies the existing idiom in SQLCompiler.setup_query, and the formatting matches the file.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: It is a three-line change inside single_alias that reuses query.get_initial_alias() and the guard pattern already in setup_query. There is no duplicated logic, dead code or debug output, and Collector and QuerySet.delete are untouched.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: No error handling is needed here. The guard only adds the base alias when no alias is referenced yet, so it avoids bumping refcounts on queries that already have joins. There are no magic constants and no swallowed errors.

items.name: Subquery dropped only for genuine single-table deletes
items.name_zh: 仅在真正单表删除时去掉子查询
items.evidence: The root cause is fixed in SQLDeleteCompiler.single_alias, which registers the base alias before counting. Joined deletes still use the subquery (the agent checked the avatar__desc filter), and the MySQL compiler benefits through single_alias. The hidden tests pass: F2P 1/1, P2P 52/52.
